plan.scope: Offline prototype after tournament freeze; no entry/runtime/SDK/champion edits, deployment, commits or remote operations
plan.new_route: Online information-set sampled full-terminal rollouts; not real-hidden-deal counterfactual labels and not one-step dawn utility
plan.information_boundary: Construct only hypothetical worlds consistent with own role/checks and public death facts; add authenticated noncontradictory dead-seer reports. Never access evaluator seed, opponent implementation/type, hidden actual roles, or actual future ballots. Root action is common across all hypotheses.

model.role_weights: reuse bounded existing belief inference so greedy/no-search can be a matched control
model.observed_update: bounded recent public ballot likelihoods and exact commitment adherence, no name-based opponent dispatch
model.private_seer_history: own checks exact; other living seer checks are sampled hypotheses, not recovered truth
model.future_policy: plain B0-style policy or mechanical models using only each synthetic seat's normal view; no recursive planning or perfect-information acting
model.public_transcript: visible broadcasts only for other seats; sequence IDs renumbered consistently within simulated game; own call/topics retained
model.timing: modeled future discussion uses ordinary round ordering, not claimed identical to real RT scheduling

prototype.eligible: good-role moving day votes,3to5living, valid nonterminal public state
prototype.candidates: all legal ballots including abstention except own private/dead-confirmed clears; known-wolf facts preserved in worlds, not blindly forced as the only action outside solved3person cases
prototype.switch_gate: mean modeled win advantage at least0.125 and mean-minus-one-standard-error above0; only a stability heuristic, not a valid real-world confidence interval
prototype.fixed_budget: all hypothetical games finish under engine action cap; no source-dependent lookup; deterministic seed from permitted view only
prototype.chat_and_night: outer actual chat/night remains B0, planner runs only at actual moving vote; communication mismatch is an explicit limitation

profiles.greedy: same role beliefs but no future simulation
profiles.rollout_prior: full terminal planning, fixed style mixture
profiles.rollout_observed: full terminal planning with observation-based style update

replication.selection: Among the two planning profiles select highest pooled paired gain; ties prefer fixed prior. If neither is positive, at most the closest diagnostic may be repeated, not called a positive candidate.

plan.additional_checks: If positive on both271and272, selected version only:273rounds50games per eachB0background, then273rt100games perfirst_switch,pop_anti_majority,mixed:first+random+llmq,mixed:heuristic+llmq+pop_coordinated. All profiles/negative slices preserved. Holdouts41901/41902 only after stable development, unchanged2pp/nonregression bar. New opponent-family/real-platform generalization not established by new deal seeds.
plan.model_diagnostics: For every planned real vote record other-voter forecasts from the16reference-action particles, then score against actual completed ballots after the game. Report top1 accuracy, multiclassBrier and logloss with0.02uniform smoothing; no actual ballots enter planning. These diagnostics are not win-rate evidence.
risks: future communication model differs from actual opponents
actual public vote announcement may differ from later planned ballot
more compute need not improve win rate

scope: new planner prototype, local scripted development; no deployment or live strength claim
